resources.string: Allow Galaxy Game to send three daily game reminders around 8 AM, 12 PM and 8 PM in your local time. You can turn them off any time in Android settings.

string-array.name: daily_notification_messages
string-array.item: Open Galaxy Game and choose a game for your next break.
